scope: Hash and private-archive member register. No source images or private access identifiers are published.
reading_rule: A prepared or archived image is not automatically inspected. Reader-specific coverage records determine actual inspection.
provenance: Private reader manifests retain publication, source hash, printed/viewer page, figure, rendering, caption/credit and reuse details; originals are identified in the source inventory.
reuse: Private reference derivatives from supplied sources; public redistribution permission unestablished.
